FOUNDRY_MCP.Settings.BridgeUrl.Name: Control channel WebSocket URL
FOUNDRY_MCP.Settings.BridgeUrl.Hint: WebSocket control endpoint exposed by the MCP server. Saving this setting reconnects immediately.
FOUNDRY_MCP.Settings.BridgeSecret.Name: Control channel secret
FOUNDRY_MCP.Settings.BridgeSecret.Hint: Shared secret used for challenge authentication on the control channel. Saving this setting reconnects immediately. Visible to GMs only.
FOUNDRY_MCP.Settings.Diagnostics.Name: Diagnostic logging
FOUNDRY_MCP.Settings.Diagnostics.Hint: Log connection diagnostics. Secrets and payloads are never logged.
FOUNDRY_MCP.Settings.AssistantSetup.Name: Offer assistant account setup
FOUNDRY_MCP.Settings.AssistantSetup.Hint: On the next full-GM login, offer to create the dedicated backend service user. Disable this after creation or dismissal.
FOUNDRY_MCP.Settings.AgentControlSelecti: Last agent, model, and permission mode selected for each AgentControl slot.
